title: OpenGHM spatial coverage
description: A bounding box in DCMI Box element names, shared by every OpenGHM artifact spec (ADR 0018) — see metadata-format.md#spatialcoverage for why. The DCMI `box`, `name`, `uplimit`, `downlimit` and `zunits` elements are deliberately absent: `box` restates the four limits, and the rest describe a vertical extent WBM does not model.

units.description: The unit the four limits are expressed in. One value today, because WBM refuses to run a network that is not geographic — same reasoning as runtime.execution.cluster. A second unit is an additive MINOR bump.

projection.description: The coordinate reference system of the grid this coverage describes. One value, because WBM dies on any other — see metadata-format.md#spatialcoverage. A source projection may be an EPSG code, a Proj4 string or WKT, so the generator recognises the CRS and emits this form, rather than transcribing the source's spelling. A second value is an additive MINOR bump, and would come with a native-CRS block rather than alone.
